name: Quantarc
positioning: For analysts and serious self-directed learners, Quantarc is the terminal-grade research desk that turns market data into explainable signal — every chart traceable to a published method, never a tip.
audience: Independent analysts, finance writers, students of markets and small research teams who want dense, disciplined, keyboard-first analytics with transparent methodology.
strategy: Win trust through transparency rather than hype: every visual carries its method, its data lineage and an educational disclaimer. Lead with a signature visual language — regime quadrants and breadth arcs — so the brand is recognisable at feed speed, then convert curiosity into demo-desk access requests through free lessons and office hours.

contrastPairs.use: panel IDs and accents on panels

designSystem.spacing: 8px base unit; dense 16px panel padding; 1px gutters between dashboard panels; 64px+ safe margins on social canvases
designSystem.radius: 0 on panels, buttons and inputs; the only rounded form is the app-icon mark
designSystem.borders: 1px #30363D hairlines everywhere; #21262D for table row rules; amber 1–2px outline for featured or active states
designSystem.imagery: No photography. Inline SVG charts only: regime quadrants, breadth arcs, candlestick strips, sparklines — always labelled as illustrative sample data
designSystem.shapes: Quarter and half arcs, crosshair quadrants, concentric dashed rings, square bullets and terminal cursor blocks
designSystem.buttons: Square amber fill with dark ink, uppercase mono labels and a keycap hint (GO, F1, ENTER); ghost variant uses a 1px amber outline
designSystem.cards: Dashboard panels with a dark header strip carrying an amber function ID (QA-01, BR-02) and a muted status label on the right
designSystem.motifs: Arc gauges, four-quadrant regime maps with dotted trails, candlestick fragments, ticker tapes, monospace tables with tabular numerals, function-key navigation

artDirection: Every creative is composed like a terminal screen: a grid-paper night background, 1px panels with ID headers, and one dominant amber arc or quadrant that carries the story. Headlines are set in heavy JetBrains Mono with the payoff word in Signal Amber; supporting copy uses Inter for readability. Green and red appear only as data colours, never as decoration, and every chart is marked as illustrative sample data with an 'educational, not financial advice' line. Vary the hero graphic per platform (arc sweep, gauge, quadrant, candle anatomy) while keeping the lockup, panel headers and amber CTA block constant.
